target_customer: Brands and marketers who need a constant supply of ad creative
problem: Producing consistent ad images and video at volume is slow. Ad Army keeps a brand's characters, products and locations consistent across generated variants and replays workflows.
business_model: Credit based subscription tiers for individuals and per seat team plans

founders.name: Jonathan Aeschlimann
education: Executive education at Stanford GSB and Chicago Booth

founders.name: Lourenço Maciel
previous_startups: an eCommerce company selling in over 30 countries (name not given)
founders.background_notes: YC page says 12 years in digital marketing and taught himself to code in 2021.

technical_complexity.rationale: Orchestrating third party image, video and audio models with consistency controls is standard engineering with some hard parts; the company does not train foundation models.

defensibility.rationale: Model agnostic wrapper on third party models; many similar tools exist.

market_need_then: Brands need a constant supply of ad creative; dated 2022 demand evidence was not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Tagline: Your next ad starts here

brand_strength.rationale: A catchy name and domain hack but no brand press found; search results for the brand returned only US Army material.

pivots.from: AI tool generating ad campaigns from a single brief (per a Startup-Seeker profile)
pivots.to: AI creative studio starting from product photos with brand worlds, video and MCP integration

outcome_analysis: Ad Army is still active with a small team and a current multi-tier credit pricing page, after a 2022 start as an AI ad generator. The product has evolved with new video and image models, but no verified funding, revenue or press was found, so success or failure cannot be judged from public sources.
notes: Unverified aggregator figures: Dealroom lists 125K seed, Startup-Seeker about 500K total; no primary source. Location conflicts (YC and Dealroom say London, Dealroom HQ field says Salt Lake City). No Ad Army coverage dated 2022 found; known adjacent players such as Omneky and Pencil appeared only in 2026 comparison pages without dated founding-era sources, so the competitor list is empty. The pivot comes from a profile comparison and is undated.
